description: This is a FastAPI backend API implementation for a career pathway navigator application. It provides endpoints for health checks, role and skill management, progress tracking, graph generation for role transitions, recommendations, assessments, and roadmap CRUD operations. The file orchestrates database interactions, request handling, and response formatting, with detailed route definitions and logic for constructing role-skill graphs with gap highlighting.

methods.name: on_startup
methods.description: Initializes database, creates tables, runs schema migrations, and seeds data on app startup.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Returns a simple health status payload.

methods.name: list_roles
methods.description: Fetches and returns all available roles with descriptions.

methods.name: get_role_detail
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a role by name, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: get_role_detail_by_id
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a role by ID, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: list_skills
methods.description: Fetches and returns all available skills with details.

methods.name: get_skill_detail
methods.description: Fetches skill details by ID, including roles that require it.

methods.name: get_skill_detail_by_name
methods.description: Fetches skill details by name, including roles that require it.

methods.name: get_role_progress
methods.description: Lists progress entries for a specified role.

methods.name: set_progress
methods.description: Creates or updates progress for a role's skill.

methods.name: get_graph
methods.description: Generates a D3-compatible graph illustrating role transition gaps and nodes.

methods.name: get_recommendations
methods.description: Fetches recommendations for a role-skill pair.

methods.name: assess_roles
methods.description: Compares current and target roles to identify strengths and gaps.

methods.name: create_roadmap
methods.description: Creates and saves a new roadmap with associated roles and payload.

methods.name: list_roadmaps
methods.description: Lists saved roadmaps, optionally filtered by user.

methods.name: get_roadmap
methods.description: Fetches a specific roadmap by ID.

methods.name: update_roadmap
methods.description: Updates an existing roadmap's name, payload, or notes.
